title: campanula rotundifolia f. nejceffii
intro: Campanula rotundifolia f. nejceffii, commonly known as the Hairy Bellflower, is a flowering plant species in the Campanulaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Campanula rotundifolia f. nejceffii include being a diuretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory, which can aid in relieving symptoms of urinary tract infections, bronchitis, and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
